title: Booklet — Green Horizon: Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology
fileSize: 3.3–3.8 MB • 4 Official Language Editions (EN, DE, TR, RO)
description: The complete Educational Booklet (Open Educational Resource) developed under Erasmus+ grant 2024-3-DE04-KA210-YOU-000293009. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains Chapter I (Climate Change Mitigation Strategies), Chapter II (Photography for Climate Storytelling), and Chapter III (Drone Operation for Climate Documentation) complete with field checklists and flight exercises.
modules: Chapter I: Practical Insights Into Climate Change Mitigation Strategies (Conceptual Framework, 5 Local Indicators, Community-Based Observation, Evidence to Action, Youth Leadership)
Chapter II: Photography for Climate Storytelling (Image Formation, Composition Rules, Environmental Observation, Visual Narratives, Aerial vs Ground Perspectives, Communication Ethics)

Chapter III: Drone Operation for Climate Documentation (Drone Anatomy & Flight Modes, EU & Turkish Aviation Rules, Flight Planning & Weather, 6 Flight Exercises, 7 Shot Types, 9-Step Video Editing, Printable Field Checklist)

title: Printable Drone Documentation Field Checklist (Page 97)
description: The exact one-page pre-flight, on-site, and post-flight safety protocol from Page 97 of the Green Horizon Booklet. Covers registration, insurance, weather limits (wind <30 km/h), satellite home lock, 120m AGL ceiling, and battery safety.
modules: Phase 1: BEFORE — Permissions, certificate, insurance, weather & wind checks, battery charge, team roles
Phase 2: ON SITE — Consent, safe LZ, home point recorded, hover check at 2–3m, VLOS & 120m ceiling, 30% battery margin
Phase 3: AFTER — Flight log, backup with GPS metadata, blurring faces/plates, video editing, battery storage charge

title: Drone Flight Safety Protocol & Field Checklist
description: Essential safety checklist utilized in the Romania Training Course (A2) and the three Local Youth Workshops (A4). Details pre-flight risk checks, weather tolerance thresholds, GNSS calibration, battery handling, and ethical privacy safeguards under GDPR.
modules: 18-Point Pre-Flight Safety Protocol
Airspace Verification & Geofencing Limits
Emergency Failsafe & Return-to-Home Procedures
Ethical Aerial Filming & Respect for Wildlife

title: Youth Documentary Production Guide: From Raw Footage to Climate Advocacy
leadPartner: Asociatia Empower Plus with Integrational e.V.
description: Practical guide on editing 4K aerial footage and ground interviews into impactful short documentaries (2–10 minutes) addressing regional environmental degradation and climate adaptation.
modules: Visual Narrative Structures for Environmental Journalism
Non-Linear Video Editing with Accessible Open Tools
Color Grading Aerial Drone Clips for Visual Clarity
Multilingual Subtitling, Voiceovers, and Accessible Audio

title: Curator's Guide to Virtual Climate Exhibitions on MetaSteps
description: Step-by-step technical manual on curating aerial and high-resolution photo exhibitions on the MetaSteps platform, complete with interactive guided tours and ambient soundscapes.
modules: Capturing Equirectangular Aerial Panoramas
Setting Up 3D Exhibition Spaces on the MetaSteps Platform
Curating Informative Captions and Environmental Data Points
Designing Guided Virtual Tours for Schools and Community Centers

title: Local Youth Workshop Facilitator Kit: Training 60 Youth Across DE, TR, and RO
description: Turnkey pedagogical blueprint for youth workers facilitating the 1-day local workshops in Germany, Türkiye, and Romania, reaching a minimum of 60 youth participants with hands-on flight simulation and climate dialogue.
modules: Module 1: Introduction to Drone Operation, Setup & Regulations
Module 2: Photography & Videography Techniques for Landscape Documentation
Module 3: Basic Video Editing & Visual Storytelling Exercises
Module 4: Climate Advocacy Discussion & Youth Action Planning
